name: Sakuma Shu
source:
"Why is it really that important? Things about me..."

A dancer at 'Dance Trips', he also plays piano as accompaniment. He used to be a conductor in Germany.
He has the mysterious personality of an artist and has a peculiar way of speaking, so it's hard to hold a conversation with him.
There seems to be some kind of reason why he quit being a conductor and moved back to Japan but...?
